checks.label: ADB Keys Present
checks.description: Presence of adb_keys may indicate previously trusted host
checks.remediation: Remove unauthorized keys with 'adb shell rm /data/misc/adb/adb_keys' and reboot the device.

checks.label: ADB Over Network Port
checks.description: Should be empty or disabled; non-default = risk
checks.remediation: Disable ADB over network by running 'adb shell setprop service.adb.tcp.port -1' and restarting ADB.

checks.label: System Debug Binaries
checks.description: Presence of debug tools increases attack surface
checks.remediation: Remove debug binaries with 'adb shell rm /system/bin/gdbserver /system/bin/strace' on a remounted system.

checks.label: Kernel DebugFS Enabled
checks.description: Kernel debugfs enabled exposes sensitive kernel interfaces
checks.remediation: Disable debugfs by setting CONFIG_DEBUG_FS=n in the kernel config and rebuilding the boot image.
